line: Invert. What would guarantee you are still unemployed in twelve months? Then do none of that.
It is remarkable how much long-term advantage people like us have gotten by trying to be consistently not stupid, instead of trying to be very intelligent.
If you don't own a piece of a business, you don't have a path toward financial freedom. Applications buy runway. Ownership buys wealth.
You will never be worth more than you think you are. Value your time at an aspirational hourly rate and ruthlessly pull yourself out of anything below it.
Fortunes require leverage. Code, media, capital, people. Renting your hours will never get you there.
Arm yourself with specific knowledge, accountability, and leverage. Then play long-term games with long-term people.
The difference between successful people and really successful people is that really successful people say no to almost everything.
Life is like a snowball. The important thing is finding wet snow and a really long hill. Skill hours compound. Scroll hours do not.
Know your circle of competence and stay inside it. Targeted applications beat spray-and-pray.
Rule No. 1: never lose money. Rule No. 2: never forget rule No. 1. Protect runway. Do not skip the required work.
Project yourself to age 80. Will you regret not sending the application, or regret the video you watched instead?
I knew that when I was 80 I was not going to regret having tried this. I knew I would regret not trying.
Boil things down to the most fundamental truths and reason up from there. 'I need to feel ready' is not a fundamental truth.
There are so many people working so hard and achieving so little. Output is what counts. Sent applications. Not tabs.
The work of a business is to inspect reality, then act. Skip the evening review and you are flying without instruments.
There is nothing so useless as doing efficiently that which should not be done at all.
It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a great deal of it.
Make the best use of what is in your power, and take the rest as it happens. Sending the application is in your power.
Clarity about what matters provides clarity about what does not. If the quota is open, this app is waste.
Every action you take is a vote for the type of person you wish to become. Sending is a vote. Scrolling is a vote.
Positive fantasies make you feel accomplished without acting. Name the obstacle. Then the if-then.
If this situation, then this action. Vague hope is not a plan. Write the if-then and run it.
Never take a risk that can take you out of the game. Skip enough required days and the game is already over.
The big money is not in the buying and selling, but in the waiting. Waiting is not scrolling. Waiting is compounding skill.
What was supposed to happen. What happened. Why. What we do tomorrow. That is the review. Anything else is a diary.
